title: OVERRIDE: note to note kept context edge cannot drive structBoost over HTTP
summary: SPEC IS INCOMPLETE: the CL adapter's edge keep/prune verdict is faithful but its retrieval effect is INERT for note↔note edges over the current daemon HTTP surface. Two daemon-side causes, both verified 2026-06-15: (1) buildGraph (daemon.js ~L1612) pushes note nodes with a hardcoded context_deps: [], and the structBoost reranker (routes/graph.js ~L363-396) builds adjacency only from node.context_deps — so a kept note→note edge never enters the adjacency and structBoost stays 0 no matter the verdict; (2) overlayStore.save (lib/overlay.js ~L262-264) only emits edge_added for edges whose signature is NOT already in prev.edges, so keepEdge's in-place promotion of an existing autowire edge (judged:false→true, weight:0→score) is NOT persisted for a non-live (isolated eval) workspace — /judge/verdict returns kept:1 but reload shows weight:0. NET: keepEdge/pruneEdge post and journal correctly, but the only DEMONSTRABLE retrieval lever the judge controls is the dup-cluster decision (markDistinct makes a near-dup note retrieval-visible; consolidate supersedes it, pruned from retrieval). Clean fix (gated, restart-required): give note nodes real context_deps from kept edges + emit an edge-update event on in-place promotion.
